name: Shuttlewick
lore: An animated wooden weaving shuttle that stitches roads from rose-coloured thread. Fire to lay a seam, then ride it; walls always interrupt the route.

primary.name: Running Stitch
primary.description: Fire a thread needle and leave a visible 360-length seam for 6s. Your next stitch replaces the seam.

secondary.name: Seam Ride
secondary.description: Zip toward the end of your last seam, cutting each crossed enemy once. Without a seam, dash 140 toward your aim. Walls stop travel.

special.name: Four-Corner Loom
special.description: Weave a 125-radius diamond field for 5s. Pulses once a second and slows foes by 40%.

passive: Hemmed In: Completing Seam Ride grants 10% damage reduction for 1.5s.

technique.name: Long Seam
technique.description: Stitches reach 480 instead of 360, but hit for 18 instead of 24.

final_technique.name: Loose Ends
final_technique.description: Replace the control field with three heavy thread darts: 36 damage each, 8s cooldown. Requires close alignment to land all three.

attack.name: Loose Ends
attack.description: Three heavy needles in a fan; each stops on the first target.
